description.value: St. Andrews By The Lake Golf Resort is a scenic nine-hole golf resort set among rolling hills and willow-lined lakeside views in Kaleden, BC, about 15 minutes south of Penticton. Overnight guests stay in one of five clubhouse guestrooms or a fully furnished suite, each with a private entrance and walk-out patio overlooking the course. On-site amenities include a heated outdoor pool and The Painted Turtle Bistro, which serves pub-style food and drinks on a patio framed by the South Okanagan landscape.

address.value: 111 St. Andrews Drive, Kaleden, BC V0H 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating golf resort and accommodation in Kaleden, BC (not Penticton as the OSM community field implies), with five guestrooms and a suite in the lower level of the golf clubhouse. The Painted Turtle Bistro is confirmed on-site, providing evening food for guests. No bike-specific amenities—storage, tools, wash station, e-bike charging, or laundry—are mentioned anywhere on the website, so all such fields remain null.
